description: Handwritten scenario-to-semantic expectations for functional correctness evaluation. Expected labels are based on scripted scenarios in event_generator.py. low_motivation is marked as provisional because the active rule definitions were not available in the uploaded files.

baseline.notes: Negative control. Baseline EMA values should ideally not emit semantic_events. Any emitted semantic label should be treated as a false positive unless justified by current rules.

stress_rising.notes: Stress rises strongly over time while motivation and self-efficacy decrease.

craving_rising.notes: Craving rises strongly over time; stress also rises more mildly.

low_motivation.notes: This scenario is defined in event_generator.py, but the uploaded files did not include rules.py / evaluate_rules(). Use this row as provisional and update it after checking the actual rule thresholds.

relapse_risk.notes: Combined deterioration with high craving, high stress, falling motivation and self-efficacy, plus occasional low receptivity / meeting / moving context.

mixed_risk.notes: The mixed_risk mode does not emit scenario='mixed_risk' in the raw events. Instead, it cycles through baseline, stress_rising, craving_rising, and relapse_risk phases. For correctness evaluation, use the per-event scenario field, not the mode name.
